title: Optimize INT8/FP8 quantized kernels and dequant fusion for smoothquant inference paths
author: Aisha Gupta
description:
Context: quantized inference paths (INT8/FP8) with smoothquant preprocessing are critical for our Dedicated and Hosted customers. Prior work split dequantize steps and kernel execution which increased memory traffic and prevented some fusion optimizations. This PR implements a combined dequant+matmul kernel path and scheduling heuristics that favor fused execution for common smoothquant patterns, plus KV-cache aware memory layout changes to reduce peak memory and improve cache locality.

Why: benchmarks indicated a consistent 20-35% throughput regression on INT8 paths vs. optimized FP16 hotpaths for medium sequence lengths (128-512) due to extra dequant passes and suboptimal kernel launches. This work aims to: 1) remove the extra gather/dequant memory copy, 2) expose fusion opportunities to the kernel selector, 3) prefer continuous-batching targets that maximize GPU warp utilization for batched short sequences.

What changed (high level): 1) new fused_kernel_int8_dequant_matmul.cu - single kernel doing dequant->scale->matmul for INT8/FP8 inputs when smoothquant metadata present; 2) kernel selector updates to prefer fused path for models matching a smoothquant pattern; 3) KV cache layout tweaks (kvcache/packed layout) to reduce memory copies when the fused kernel is used; 4) scheduler heuristic: prefer continuous batching groups where percent short-seq requests > 60%; 5) added unit/integration/perf tests and updated docs.

Checklist: - [x] Design doc in Linear (ENG-9832) - [x] Unit tests - [x] Integration tests (GPU) - [x] Perf regression tests + benchmarks - [x] Backwards-compatible: falls back to previous dequant path when unsupported.

Notes: this PR keeps the fallback path for models that use custom quant scales or unsupported tensor layouts; the selector logs a metric for the fraction of inference requests that hit the fused path. Migration: ops are gated behind a runtime flag (enable_quant_fusion) that we will flip for Dedicated customers in a staged rollout.

benchmark_summary: A100-80GB, INT8 smoothquant model, batch dynamic (continuous batching): throughput +28% (tokens/s) vs previous INT8 path
p95 latency reduced by 12% for 512-token requests under 50 concurrent users
KV cache peak memory reduced by ~18% for end-to-end inference due to eliminated intermediate dequant buffers
T4 microbench: fused kernel improves small-batch (batch=4) throughput by 15% and reduces host-device memcpy by 1.2ms per request
release_notes: Optimize quantized inference: fused dequant+matmul kernel for INT8/FP8 smoothquant paths; improves throughput and reduces memory usage. Enabled behind feature flag enable_quant_fusion. Rollout: staged for Dedicated customers.
